timeline: You are walking through your basement wall in 1963 when you accidentally discover an entire underground city carved nearly three hundred feet deep.
Deep beneath Turkey, twenty thousand people vanished underground.
Entire families hid down here for months.
Stables, chapels, and wine presses filled five hidden levels.
Massive stone doors sealed the tunnels from the inside.
Ventilation shafts kept the deep city breathing.
Raider armies searched the surface above in vain.
Then in nineteen sixty-three, a broken basement wall revealed it all.
How did twenty thousand people live in the Derinkuyu underground city carved nearly three hundred feet beneath the earth?
